tasks.title: Create ProgramRosterResolver + get_program_roster_resolver dependency
tasks.notes: Single-tier resolver: __init__(self) holds only self._cache: dict[str, tuple[list[str], float]] = {} and self._lock = Lock() -- no session_factory (D-01: db is a per-call argument, not resolver-owned). async def resolve(self, email: str, db: AsyncSession) -> list[str]: fast path returns a warm (time.monotonic() < expiry) cache hit immediately, logging tier=cache_hit; miss path acquires self._lock, re-checks the cache (double-checked, bounds concurrent misses for the same email to one query), then runs SELECT DISTINCT program_id FROM program_roster WHERE email = :email AND removed_at IS NULL via db.execute(select(distinct(ProgramRoster.program_id)).where(...)) wrapped in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=3.0) -- a TimeoutError raises ProgramRosterResolutionError('program_roster query timeout after 3.0s'), never hangs. Only a successful resolution is cached (a raise is never negative-cached). _log_resolution emits logger.info('program_membership_resolved', extra={tier, program_count, timestamp}) on every call, cache hit or miss -- exact 3-field allowlist, no email, no program_id list (NFR-security). get_program_roster_resolver(request: Request) -> ProgramRosterResolver: return request.app.state.program_roster_resolver, mirroring get_persona_resolver verbatim.
